import os, sys, json, hashlib, tempfile, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from finetune.eval_review_deployment import build_compatible_tokenizer, _read_gguf_tokenizer_metadata
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
base=json.loads(Path('docs/results/ollama-tokenizer-reference-20261015.json').read_text())
spec=base['spec']; implementation=sha('finetune/eval_review_deployment.py')
expectedlibs={item['path']:item['sha256'] for item in spec['installed_libraries'].values()}
assert sha(spec['helper']['path'])==spec['helper']['sha256']
for p,h in expectedlibs.items():assert sha(p)==h
extra=['cafe\u0301','café',"we'ſmore 'S 'ſ 'İ 'ı 'K",'a\u0327\u0301 A\u030a \u1100\u1161','👩\u200d🔬 🏳️\u200d🌈 العربية हिन्दी','\r\n\t\u00a0\u2028\u2029 test\x00end','[PAD0][PAD249][PAD248077][PAD248319]','<|audio_start|><|audio_end|><tts_pad><tts_text_bos><tts_text_eod><tts_text_bos_single><|audio_pad|>','<|fim_prefix|><|repo_name|><|file_sep|><tool_call></tool_call>','<|im_start|>user\ncafe\u0301<|im_end|>',' café cafe\u0301 '*20,'a\U0001c89b a\U0001c8ab','a\U00010d40b \U00011f02\U00011f04','cafe\u0301 '*4000]
report={}
for name,a in spec['models'].items():
 renderer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(a['hf_assets'],local_files_only=True,trust_remote_code=False)
 counter=build_compatible_tokenizer({'path':a['hf_assets'],'model_sha256':a['manifest']['sha256']},renderer,assets={'manifest':a['manifest'],'gguf':a['gguf']})
 texts=_read_gguf_tokenizer_metadata(a['gguf']['path'])['tokenizer.ggml.tokens'][248044:]+extra
 texts += [renderer.apply_chat_template([{'role':'user','content':'cafe\u0301 '*4000}],tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False)]
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mvllm-independent-compat-') as work:
  paths=[]
  for i,t in enumerate(texts):
   p=Path(work)/str(i);p.write_bytes(t.encode());paths.append(str(p))
  cmd=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-p','(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)','/usr/bin/arch','-x86_64',spec['helper']['path'],a['gguf']['path'],*paths]
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LC_ALL':'C','HOME':work})
  assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr[-1000:]
  assert 'vocab only - skipping tensors' in r.stderr
  loaded={s.removeprefix('AUDIT_IMAGE=') for s in r.stderr.splitlines() if s.startswith('AUDIT_IMAGE=')}
  assert set(expectedlibs)<=loaded
  assert {p for p in loaded if p.startswith('/Applications/Ollama.app/')}==set(expectedlibs)
  actual=[json.loads(s) for s in r.stdout.splitlines()]
  assert len(actual)==len(texts)
  mismatch=[]
  for i,(t,ids) in enumerate(zip(texts,actual)):
   if counter.encode(t,add_special_tokens=False)!=ids:mismatch.append({'i':i,'text':t[:100],'compat':counter.encode(t),'actual':ids})
  assert not mismatch,mismatch
  assert len(actual[-1])==8013
  report[name]={'case_count':len(texts),'exact_ids_match':True,'budget_input_tokens':len(actual[-1]),'loaded_images':sorted(loaded),'counter_identity':counter.compatibility_counter_identity}
  print(name,len(texts),'complete IDs matched; budget=',len(actual[-1]),flush=True)
for p,h in expectedlibs.items():assert sha(p)==h
assert sha(spec['helper']['path'])==spec['helper']['sha256']
assert sha('finetune/eval_review_deployment.py')==implementation
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules
Path('/tmp/mvllm-compat-review-observation-20261016.json').write_text(json.dumps({'provider_sha256':implementation,'models':report,'model_inference':False,'real_test':False,'native_server':False},indent=2))
